name: Customer Record Lookup & Update
headline: Bring customer context into the call—and write it back.
prompt: I found the account. What should I update from this conversation?
description: Retrieves customer history from an authorized system and writes confirmed call outcomes back to the record. The reference scope emphasizes least-privilege access, explicit confirmation, and auditable changes.
readiness: Illustrative workflow; validate field-level permissions, identity, data retention, and write-back confirmation in your environment.

business.buyer: Sales, service, and revenue operations leaders
business.application: Retrieve customer history during a call and write outcomes, notes, and next steps back to the system of record.
business.roi: Shorter handle time, more complete CRM records, and less after-call administration.
business.metrics: Handle time · Record completion · After-call work saved

technical.build: Authenticated record lookup, field-level writeback, call summarization, and confirmation before updates.

expected.description: Poster image for the video player (WebP).
